recap.analyst:
Guanabara FC and Thames Rovers drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.19–1.03: Thames Rovers did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Guanabara FC had 54% of the ball. Pass completion GUA 77% (141/182), TRV 67% (103/153). Shots 2–10, on target 1–1.

Guanabara FC started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: TRV to 4-2-3-1 at 67' (chasing the game).

Turning point, 79': Thames Rovers levelled the match through G. Petit. The chance was worth xG 0.11 (about 11 in 100 go in), struck at 111 km/h. Score now GUA 1-1 TRV.

By the numbers: T. Ferreira completed the most passes (21); P. Jovanović hit the top speed (32.7 km/h); G. Petit covered the most ground (5.95 km, a 16.8 km per-90 pace); N. Uribe won the most challenges (22).

Discipline: fouls 5–0, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–1. Conditions: partly cloudy, 27°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Guanabara, Rio de Janeiro. T. Ferreira broke the deadlock in the 47th minute. G. Petit struck in the 79th for Thames Rovers. Guanabara FC had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: T. Ferreira, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
